issues.detail: The Greek 'οπως αν εκζητησωσιν' (if/when they seek) is rendered as a purpose clause 'Hầu cho' (so that/in order that). The Greek structure describes a conditional/consecutive result of the seeking, not a purpose for which the seeking occurs.
The Vietnamese translation omits the conditional 'αν' (if/when), changing the logical flow from a potential action to an intended goal.
